Please note that the Hot Wheels Wiki takes a harsh stance on leaked products due to them potentially not being representative of the final product. The creation of any material containing any information pertaining to a leaked product is prohibited, whether it be an article, image or related form of media, is strictly prohibited on this Wiki and will result in the article being deleted and may result in a ban. Please consult the Editing Rules and Guidelines for more information.

Sign In to Save Save Edit
  • History
  • Purge
  • Talk (3)

This is a list of Hot Wheels released between 1989 and 1999 and sorted by collector number.

Note this does not include variations, just the car that came with that number.
